QuestInfo.name: Intruder - The Herb Farm 2
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, there was a thief at #p2092000#'s herb farm at #m251000000#...
QuestInfo.1:
#p2092000# claimed that someone had entered his herb farm and stole some of his herbs. #p2092000# seemed confident that it was the work of the red-nosed pirates, and asked me to defeat #r#o7130104##k and #r#o6130208##k.

#o7130104#  #r#a38081##k 
#o6130208#  #r#a38082##k
QuestInfo.2: I was able to defeat #o6130208# and #o7130104#. Now that I have apprehended the suspects, #p2092000# should enjoy a nice, long sleep tonight.

0.0: You're a traveler, right? Then you must be pretty good at fighting against pirates. Now please do something against them!

yes.0: What am I saying? Well, remember last time, a whole bunch of #o5120501#s invaded my farm? While I was busy protecting my farm against them, someone else walked into the farm and stole other herbs! You'll never understand how painstaking it was to grow and nurture those herbs. I am pretty sure it's the work of those pirates!
yes.1: Those pirates! It angers me greatly that they made a huge mess out of this farm, but for them to steal the herbs... they will pay for this! I want you to teach those pirates a lesson or two by defeating #r80 #o6130208#s#k and #r80 #o7130104#s#k!

no.0: You call yourself a traveler when you are unwilling to help those in need? I don't see the difference between you and the pirates.

1.0: Hoh! Thank you for eliminating both #o6130208#s and #o7130104#s. I'm sure they learned the lesson; they won't do it again... I sure hope so. Great work there!

yes.0: Those pirates only stole the most expensive herbs available. At least they have an eye for the herbs... but those herbs aren't for them! Those were for #p2091002#. I'll never get these robbed again. Ever.

item.0: You haven't eliminated #r#o6130208#s#k and #r#o7130104#s#k? They are the ones responsible for stealing my herbs, so I want you to take care of them. 100 each.
